notes: «كتب الرضا علي بن موسى إلى محمد بن سنان فيما كتب من جواب مسائله» is read as recipient-first: Ibn Sinan asked, the Imam answered in writing, and the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2); ex6's pattern (writer first) does not fit here because the Imam is the writer
needs_ruling is set because the rules do not say which of the writer and the recipient transmits when the Imam himself writes
